body:
I'm living on a military installation, and I got this soil additive mailed to me by an on-line company. This was my first time doing it, and I had heard of the revolting taste. I treated it like mushrooms by stirring it in some water. This was stupid. It all had a very muddy texture and about 75% of it sank to the bottom. I spent an hour tricking my body to ingest the whole thing, but by god I did it.
Its pretty different. I've tripped on mushrooms a bunch, and have done acid once even. And I had heard of the trips people have had on mescaline.. but this wasn't as intense as god ripping the roof off my house, or the earth opening to show me the birth of meaning. It was more real and less in my face as mushrooms. More raw than Acid. Its hard for me to translate the feeling into words. The best way I could describe it is a good medium between the euphoric bubbly happy feeling of mushrooms and the nightmarish 'reality-is-peeling-away' feeling of salvia. Just me though.
